req.title: Return GET request metadata
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /get with a JSON object containing the request's URL, headers, arguments, and origin IP.
expected_outcomes: JSON body with keys url, args, headers, origin
error_pathways: HTTP 405 if a non-GET method is used

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /get returns HTTP 200 with a JSON body containing exactly the keys 'url', 'args', 'headers', and 'origin'. Error pathway requires HTTP 405 for non-GET methods. Tests cover: (1) positive EP – plain GET returns 200 with all four required keys present and non-null; (2) positive EP – query string args are reflected exactly in the 'args' key; (3) negative NEG – POST to /get returns 405 (method not allowed); (4) negative NEG – PUT to /get returns 405; (5) boundary BVA – GET with zero query params yields empty 'args' dict; (6) boundary BVA – GET with multiple query params yields all reflected; (7) DT – custom request header is reflected in 'headers' key. Each test uses exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
No special headers or query params required
actions: Create Flask test client from httpbin.core.app
Issue GET /get with no query parameters
expected: JSON body does NOT contain extra keys beyond the four required
trace: R-HTTPBIN-001: statement – JSON object with url, args, headers, origin; HTTP 200
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert 'application/json' in r.content_type
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert set(body.keys()) == {'url', 'args', 'headers', 'origin'}
    assert body['url'] is not None
    assert body['args'] is not None
    assert body['headers'] is not None
    assert body['origin'] is not None

test_get_returns_200_with_required_keys()

trace: R-HTTPBIN-001: 'args' key must reflect request query parameters
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_reflects_query_args_exactly():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get?foo=bar&baz=qux')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert body['args'] == {'foo': 'bar', 'baz': 'qux'}
    assert 'foo=bar' in body['url']
    assert 'baz=qux' in body['url']

test_get_reflects_query_args_exactly()

tests.name: test_get_reflects_custom_request_header
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
A custom header X-Test-Header is sent with the request
actions: Issue GET /get with header X-Test-Header: sentinel-value
expected: JSON body 'headers' contains key 'X-Test-Header' with value 'sentinel-value'
JSON body 'headers' is a dict (not None, not empty)
trace: R-HTTPBIN-001: 'headers' key must reflect incoming request headers
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
import json

def test_get_reflects_custom_request_header():
    client = app.test_client()
    r = client.get('/get', headers={'X-Test-Header': 'sentinel-value'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = json.loads(r.data)
    assert isinstance(body['headers'], dict)
    headers_lower = {k.lower(): v for k, v in body['headers'].items()}
    assert headers_lower.get('x-test-header') == 'sentinel-value'

test_get_reflects_custom_request_header()
